instruction: Put the potato and tomato in the pot. Retrieve the spatula and lightly stir the vegetables in the pot.

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: at least one of the two vegetables lies in the pot and the gripper is no longer touching it.
stage_definitions.does_not_count: no vegetable is in the pot yet (still on the counter, held, or dropped outside).

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: both vegetables lie in the pot and the gripper is not touching them.
stage_definitions.does_not_count: only one vegetable is in the pot, or the gripper is still holding the second one.

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: the gripper is holding the spatula and the spatula is lifted off the counter.
stage_definitions.does_not_count: the spatula still lies on the counter, or the gripper touches it without holding it up.

stage_definitions.counts_as_complete: while holding the spatula, the robot has pushed both vegetables around inside the pot (the vegetables visibly move), with the pot on the burner of the task.
stage_definitions.does_not_count: the spatula has not touched the vegetables, the vegetables did not move, or the robot is not holding the spatula.
